cc @ashley-cui

I am not confident if it supports it all to be honest - all i noticed is that there was a different issue that added supported image volumes (via compat api), but without this extra change it blocks image-volumes through docker-compose.

I have tested the above, and it does cause image volumes to work with a caveat that the subpath part of docker-compose is not working. Possibly the compat api does not support that part of it. i could have a go at fixing it in this change if oyu want me to.

I have not used an LLM (for minors changes like this LLMs are more then likely just going to cause entropy..)
i have fixed the subpath issue and i did add some simple unit tests for it.

Have read the contributing.MD (did read it before making the PR), but not sure if i have missed something. Probably have. `make validatepr` gave some errors about windows.
I can go check 1.44 to 1.48 differences.

There are a decent amount of changes and hard for me to know if they are all covered. One thing to note is as we are using 1.56 of the moby/docker API contract on submission, it would at least be unlikely to cause any major failures. That is why before i added the subpath mount change it worked, just that the subpath mount was not respected.
If there is anything else i need to do please say, think it's all ok atm. I am not sure why those builds are failing though
Please also properly sign the commit to make DCO happy.
Ahh whoops. I think I did with the first couple commits but forgot afterwards.
Sure, I'll take a look. Will build up the rest of the changes when I have time

Listing through findings:


1.45  https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v145-api-changes
* SubPath volumes option - Already exists in compat api
* /images/search no is-automated - Already implemented
* Removed ContainerConfig and Container fields from images response - Already implemented due to Docker API being used in podman being Docker API 1.56
* Aliases in GET /containers/{name}/json no longer includes the short container ID; - **Aliases does not appear to be a field in the 1.56 version of docker api we are using, so not sure if we can meet this.**

1.46 https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v146-api-changes
* Containerd field - We don't fill this in.
* POST /containers/create field NetworkingConfig.EndpointsConfig.DriverOpts, and POST /networks/{id}/connect field EndpointsConfig.DriverOpts, now support label com.docker.network.endpoint.sysctls for setting per-interface sysctls - **I am not confident to implement this, but it is not implemented.**
* GET /containers/json now returns the annotations of containers. - Already implemented
* Images/push platform - Already supported
* POST /containers/create now takes Options as part of HostConfig.Mounts.TmpfsOptions to set options for tmpfs mounts. - Already supproted
* POST /services/create - I am assuming we do not support swarm.
* GET /events supports image create - supported

1.47 https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v147-api-changes
* Manifests field in /images/json - not supported, but said to be experiemental and does not look like it ever became not experimental.
* GET /info no longer includes warnings when bridge-nf-call-iptables or bridge-nf-call-ip6tables are disabled when the daemon was started. - Not relevant to podman

1.48 https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v148-api-changes
* GET /images/{name}/history now supports a platform parameter (JSON encoded OCI Platform type) that allows to specify a platform to show the history of. - **currently not supported**
* POST /images/{name}/load and GET /images/{name}/get now support a platform - **currently not supported**
* POST /containers/create now includes a warning in the response when setting the container-wide Config.VolumeDriver - not relevant
* POST /containers/create now supports Mount of type image for mounting an image inside a container. - this ticket
* Sysctls in HostConfig (top level --sysctl settings) for eth0 are no longer migrated to DriverOpts, as described in the changes for v1.46. - Related to the change in 1.46 i mentioned. PRobably needs to be supported, but i am not sure how.
* GET /containers/{name}/json now returns an ImageManifestDescriptor field containing the OCI descriptor of the platform-specific image manifest of the image that was used to create the container. This field is only populated if the daemon provides a multi-platform image store. - **not sure if relevant**
* POST /networks/create now has an EnableIPv4 field. Setting it to false disables IPv4 IPAM for the network. It can only be set to false if the daemon has experimental features enabled. - Experimental, we set default to true.
* POST /networks/{id}/connect and POST /containers/create now accept a GwPriority field in EndpointsConfig. - ** not supported **
* GET /containers/json now returns a GwPriority field in NetworkSettings for each network endpoint - ** not supported **
* API debug endpoints (GET /debug/vars, GET /debug/pprof/, GET /debug/pprof/cmdline, GET /debug/pprof/profile, GET /debug/pprof/symbol, GET /debug/pprof/trace, GET /debug/pprof/{name}) are now also accessible through the versioned-API paths (/v<API-version>/<endpoint>). - ** not supported, not sure if needed **
* POST /build/prune renames keep-storage to reserved-space and now supports additional prune parameters max-used-space and min-free-space. - Supported
* GET /containers/json now returns an ImageManifestDescriptor field matching the same field in /containers/{name}/json. This field is only populated if the daemon provides a multi-platform image store. - ** not sure if relevant **

So, relevant ones..

This field is only populated if the daemon provides a multi-platform image store. - **not sure if relevant**
* POST /networks/{id}/connect and POST /containers/create now accept a GwPriority field in EndpointsConfig. - ** not supported **

* GET /containers/json now returns an ImageManifestDescriptor field matching the same field in /containers/{name}/json. This field is only populated if the daemon provides a multi-platform image store. - ** not sure if relevant **

There is quite a lot of code supporting 1.48 compatible things, but some missing changes. There is a significant amount of additions in 1.48 around platformed images, which podman apis do not appear to support atm (i.e getting a specific platformed image out of image load etc.)

Hi, I created an epic tracking all the necessary changes. Feel free to start implementing the missing pieces across separate PRs. Once everything is finished, we’ll bump the supported API version.
